name: Vesicular-Novena
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by an orbital debris ring near the terminator.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Established during the last boom, the research outpost was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
There is money in iron here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
